required_behavior: F1: validate the data dir against ~/.omp (and the user store dir) BEFORE creating anything; a refused start leaves no new directory anywhere.

F2: isolation classification resolves the user's OMP data locations with the user's original env (incl. XDG_DATA_HOME), not the stripped check env, so $XDG_DATA_HOME/omp files opened by a wb OMP count as leaks.

F3: Workbench OMPs must not create new files in the user's OMP locations. Find how OMP chooses the natives extraction dir (and any other install-level cache) and point it inside the wb root if a supported env/setting exists; if OMP offers no way, keep the user's natives dir readable but ensure no new natives are written there by Workbench-started OMPs where avoidable, and document precisely what remains (e.g. OMP upgrade extracting a new natives version) in the isolation notes - report which option you took with evidence (fake HOME tests incl. XDG user).
F4: update EVIDENCE_OMP_VERSIONS isolation to 18.4.5 with the live evidence reference, keeping the drift mechanism.
acceptance: make tests/backend/test_omp_home_independent_p27u.py fully green without editing it; own red->green tests in tests/backend/test_omp_home.py for F1-F3
run tests/backend, tests/contracts, tests/ui (test_*.py, no pipe, venv), tests/gates/g1_vt; live WB_LIVE_HOME=1 tests.backend.live_omp_home_independent_p27u once
rules: Never read/print/copy/hash credential contents (metadata only); no strace buffer capture; no model prompts; no omp token/auth-broker/auth-gateway/config set/login/logout; temp dirs only under /tmp, removed afterwards; kill only PIDs you started; never touch ~/wb-urux-sandbox or the user's running processes; never edit ~/.omp ~/.agents ~/.claude ~/.codex or shell configs; list (do not delete) any file an OMP you start writes into ~/.omp; no commits, no graphify update.
result_format: checks table first, status, F1-F4 resolution with evidence, changed paths + sha256, residue. Korean, <=20 lines.
